notes.title: Patch 1.1 is live now!
notes.content:
[h1]Major patch 1.1![/h1]

Since we have so many skillful Escape Artists among us we’d like to introduce a Hard Mode for those who wish to challenge themselves even further! The Hard Mode will be available after playing the game through in normal mode. 

Patch notes

[b]Hard mode[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlocked after completing normal mode
[*]Randomization
[*]New puzzles
[*]New mechanics
[*]Sound changes
[/list]

[b]General changes[/b]
 [list]
[*]Re-lit objects throughout the game that were difficult to see at some occasions
[*]Better color coding for puzzle elements
[*]Texture changes
[*]Positional reset available inside the room by pressing Grip buttons on controller
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.02 is live now!
notes.content:
We received more feedback about frame rate drops and have revisited the problem.

Game has been tested on GTX 960 with AMD fx6300 processor and GTX 980ti with intel 3570k processor. The first test computer managed to run steady 90 fps with epic graphic settings and medium resolution (recommended VR-resolution) and with the second test computer game ran steady 90 fps with both graphic and resolution settings set to epic.

Fixes
-material changes
-lighting
-performance fixes
-minor fixes

If the problem still exists please reply to this announcement with detailed information(if the fps drops in certain place and what settings you've used when the problems occur) so we can look into it. Many thanks for everyone who posted feedback! :)

-Morrow Games

notes.title: Patch 1.01 is live now!
notes.content:
Fixes:

We have been working on the frame rate drops and it's running now around 90 fps even with Nvidia GTX 960  at epic graphics and medium resolution. 

- graphic default settings are now set at high level.
- resolution default settings are now set at medium level.
- minor physics changes.
- minor material changes.
- changes with anti-aliasing

New:

Resolution options:
- players can now change the resolution to improve the quality or performance.
- options are divided into low/medium/high/epic at 100%/140%/200%/300% of default HTC Vive Resolution.
- fps counter in menu to see if the settings are acceptable.

If the problem continues to exist or you have any feedback please do contact us at contact@morrowgames.com

-Morrow Games
